guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the cash floor, the days to invoice a job, the owner draw, the tax set-aside percent (confirm with your adviser) and the share of weekly cash in you count on.
Check Customer Accounts and Seasons. They hold your landlord and business accounts with their terms and the demand of each month.
Enter each invoice on Invoices with its dates, amount, deposit and balance, and each payment on Payments. Days outstanding, the ageing bucket and the next action fill in by themselves.
Type each completed job on Completed Jobs and the invoice number once billed. Jobs still waiting show with their days and a flag.
Write each chase contact on Chase Log with the promised date and amount. Ageing by Account and the Chase List read it.
Type the month starts on Deposits and Collections and Financing Used, and fill Profit and Loss, Cash by Month and Tax Set-aside each month.
List supplier bills on Upcoming Bills and purchases on Purchases. Cash after each bill and the floor check calculate themselves.
Type the 12 month starts on Cash Forecast. Closing cash, months of cover and the safe owner pay fill in from your own history.
Use the 18 tools: each answers one question with a verdict. Change the yellow inputs to try another day limit, cut or owner pay.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Invoices and Cash Dashboard and the Charts every week. A one-person owner-operator with one van uses the same sheets; a shop with a dispatcher uses the office columns.

listing.title: HVAC and Plumbing Contractor Excel Template: Invoices, Collections, Ageing, Chase List, Seasonal Cash Forecast, Owner Draw
listing.headline: Get paid and stay liquid through the seasons: invoices, ageing and cash
listing.description:
Get paid on time and see the cash dip before it arrives, in one Excel workbook built for an owner-run HVAC and plumbing contractor with 1 to 15 technicians and an office manager who also dispatches. A one-person owner-operator with one van uses the same sheets; a shop with a dispatcher uses the office columns.

Invoices keeps each invoice with its deposit asked and paid, balance, due date, financing used and method, and works out the days outstanding, the ageing bucket, the days past due and the next action. Completed Jobs shows the jobs finished but not invoiced. Ageing by Account groups unpaid invoices by days outstanding for each landlord and business account. The Chase Log keeps promises, amounts and outcomes. Cash by Month, Profit and Loss, Tax Set-aside, Upcoming Bills and Cash Forecast show the money side of the seasons, with a cash index for each month taken from your own history.

18 tools answer weekly questions with a clear verdict: the complete-but-not-invoiced warning, the ageing analyser, the chase list, a promise tracker, days to paid, a landlord account review, a write-off check, a seasonal cash forecast, a slow-summer test, a supplier bill and cash floor check, a safe owner draw, a tax set-aside tool, a break-even solver and profit and loss by season. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents such as the invoice, the statement and the reminder letters, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to customers, accounts, technicians, your office, the owner, your supplier and the accountant.

This is part seven of the HVAC and Plumbing Contractor suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no per-technician fee: you keep your data. A demo copy full of sample data and a blank copy are included. It helps you keep track of your business and does not promise results.
